390:t_003:3.en:
$$オットー$$
「What we should fear is $$ストラウス$$'s ability to command a fleet this size, and the combat power of her flagship!」

390:t_003:4.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「If we don't stop that ship, we have no chance of winning...!」

390:t_003:5.en:
$$ノイン$$
「But to break through that heavy armor...」

390:t_003:8.en:
$$オットー$$
「She's coming straight at us head-on! Accepting some losses, we'll slam the Hyper Mega Particle Cannon into her!」

390:t_003:9.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, defend this ship and pin down the enemy flagship's movements!!」

390:t_005:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「She means to take us on head-on!」

390:t_005:1.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Intrepid and audacious! A fearsome warlord!」

390:t_005:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「Prepare to fire the Hyper Mega Particle Cannon! All units, keep the enemy flagship in check!」

390:t_006:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「So she's seen through our every move!」

390:t_006:2.en:
$$レイアム$$
「The enemy flagship is attacking us!」

390:t_007:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「The Hyper Mega Particle Cannon's particle accelerator has been hit! At this rate the energy will flow backward!」

390:t_007:2.en:
$$レイアム$$
「It's no good! We won't make it in time!」

390:t_007:3.en:
$$オットー$$
「Damn! Rushing for the win has backfired on us!」

390:t_007:4.en:
$$レイアム$$
「The enemy flagship is coming!」

390:t_007:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「All hands, abandon ship! Much as I regret it...」

390:t_008:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Seriously?! He stopped a battleship's charge!」

390:t_008:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「We're just getting started! This isn't my real line of work!」

390:t_008:5.en:
$$メール$$
「Everybody! Pin $$ストラウス$$ down!!」

390:t_008:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「What are you planning, $$ランド$$?!」

390:t_009:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'm a repairman! I can't leave broken machines alone!」

390:t_010:0.en:
$$オットー$$
「That's no repair! You're breaking it!」

390:t_010:2.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Report from the engine room! The Hyper Mega Particle Cannon's energy line has returned to normal!」

390:t_010:3.en:
$$オットー$$
「Unbelievable! All he did was hit it with a wrench!」

390:t_010:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「Angle, force, timing! A wholehearted blow with all three in perfect harmony! With this, the distortion in the bypass is fixed for good!」

390:t_010:5.en:
$$レイアム$$
「We're good to go, Captain!」

390:t_010:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「A chance! $$ストラウス$$ is dead ahead!」

390:t_011:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「We did it! How's that!!」

390:t_011:3.en:
$$オットー$$
「I'm sorry, $$ランド$$... For saying something that doubted your professionalism.」

390:t_011:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't worry about it. I'm also in your debt, Captain, for joining me in that special training.」

390:t_011:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「For that lecture-fest full of griping...」

390:t_011:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「It showed me something. I'm not the only one enduring pain.」

390:t_011:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「Every man endures... And even more so a grown-up with responsibilities.」

390:t_011:8.en:
$$メール$$
「...You too, Darling? Is there something you've been putting up with all this time, too, Darling?」

390:t_011:9.en:
$$ランド$$
「It's pathetic, but... ever since we were fighting on $$翠の地球$$, I've been carrying this unease.」

390:t_011:11.en:
$$ランド$$
「I don't really know what it is... But the thought that someday... the world might end, never left my head...」

390:t_011:12.en:
$n
「So $$ランド$$ has been feeling the same unease I have...」

390:t_011:14.en:
$$ランド$$
「But that special training showed me. Everybody's... the same.」

390:t_011:15.en:
$$ランド$$
「These are the times we live in. Everyone endures pain.」

390:t_012:3.en:
$$メール$$
「I-I'm fine, but Darling, you're bleeding!!」

390:t_012:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「A little spit'll fix a scratch like this!」

390:t_012:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「The worst pain for me isn't the unease deep in my chest or an injury to my body! It's you getting hurt!」

390:t_012:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「As long as you keep smiling, I can endure any pain!」

390:t_012:10.en:
$$桂$$
「You'll finish this for us, won't you, $$ザ・ヒート$$!」

390:t_012:11.en:
$n
「That smile... I knew it. $$ランド$$ is my Master... $$ザ・ヒート$$!」

390:t_013:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「That last one hurt, $$ストラウス$$! As thanks, I'll show you I'm serious this time!」

390:t_013:2.en:
$$メール$$
「Go get 'em, Darling! $$ガンレオン$$!!」
